title: BLEND: A Benchmark for LLMs on Everyday Knowledge in Diverse Cultures and Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM accuracy on short-answer and multiple-choice questions about everyday knowledge (food, sports, family, etc.) across 16 different countries/regions, and conducting human evaluation to categorize errors such as stereotypical answers or applying a different country's viewpoint.

Comparing model performance on cultural knowledge questions when prompted in 13 different local languages versus English, specifically measuring the accuracy disparity between high-resource and low-resource languages.
